cases.translation: By the seventh day God finished his work.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: На седьмой день он отдыхал от своего ___.
cases.translation: On the seventh day he rested from his work.
cases.explain: The preposition от governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Господь Бог посадил сад на ___, в Эдеме.
cases.translation: The Lord God planted a garden in the east, in Eden.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: There was no man to till the ground.
cases.explain: The transitive verb обрабатывать takes a direct object in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Господь Бог создал человека из земного ___.
cases.translation: The Lord God formed the man from the dust of the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Господь Бог поселил человека в Эдемском ___.
cases.translation: The Lord God settled the man in the garden of Eden.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional (here the locative -у form).

cases.translation: A man will join with his wife.
cases.explain: The preposition с (со) in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Из ребра Господь Бог создал ___ и привел ее к нему.
cases.translation: From the rib the Lord God made a woman and brought her to him.
cases.explain: The transitive verb создал takes a direct object in the accusative.

reading.ru: Тогда Господь Бог создал человека из земного праха и вдунул ему в ноздри дыхания жизни, и человек стал живым существом.
reading.question: From what did God form the man?
options: From the dust of the earth
reading.correct: From the dust of the earth
reading.explain: The text says God created the man 'из земного праха' (from the dust of the earth).

reading.ru: Затем Господь Бог посадил сад на востоке, в Эдеме, и поселил там человека, которого Он создал.
reading.question: Where did God plant the garden?
reading.explain: The text states the garden was planted 'на востоке, в Эдеме' (in the east, in Eden).

reading.ru: Посреди же сада росли дерево жизни и дерево познания добра и зла.
reading.question: What grew in the middle of the garden?
options: The tree of life and the tree of knowledge of good and evil
reading.correct: The tree of life and the tree of knowledge of good and evil
reading.explain: The text names 'дерево жизни и дерево познания добра и зла' growing in the middle of the garden.

reading.ru: Первый называется Пишон, он течет вокруг всей земли Хавила, где есть золото.
reading.question: What is found in the land of Havilah, which the Pishon flows around?
reading.explain: The text says of the land of Havilah 'где есть золото' (where there is gold).

reading.ru: Тогда Господь Бог погрузил человека в глубокий сон, и пока тот спал, взял одно из его ребер и закрыл это место плотью.
reading.question: What did God do while the man was in a deep sleep?
options: He took one of his ribs
reading.correct: He took one of his ribs
reading.explain: The text says while the man slept God 'взял одно из его ребер' (took one of his ribs).

reading.ru: И Адам и его жена были наги, но не испытывали стыда.
reading.question: How did Adam and his wife feel about being naked?
reading.explain: The text says they were naked 'но не испытывали стыда' (but felt no shame).
